title: Ellaz fight AI file
description: One opponent's temperament. Every range is an inclusive [lo, hi] tick pair drawn with rngRange, and every probability is 0-255 compared against ONE rng byte - so the AI draws from the sim's own generator and a replay reproduces it exactly. Nothing here is a percentage: a percentage needs a division.

zTolerance.description: view px of z difference it will accept before stepping toward the target's lane

cooldownTicks.description: how long it waits between attacks

reactTicks.description: how long it takes to notice a change

retreatChance.description: 0-255, compared against one rng byte; the upper bound is the byte's, so no maximum is written here

retreatDistance.description: view px it backs off to

holdWhenTargetAttacks.description: 0-255 against one rng byte, drawn each tick the target is in a state that hits: the chance this fighter holds its ground that tick instead of walking into the swing. 0 walks straight in - a robot standing still and mashing attack took 0 hits in 6,000 ticks that way (measured 2026-09-12)

reachPad.description: view px added to the attack's own reach when deciding to swing; max is NEGATIVE here on purpose - it stops short so the swing lands rather than overshooting

tickRange.description: exactly [lo, hi], inclusive, in ticks. The validator subset has no maxItems, so data.test.ts asserts the length is 2 and that lo <= hi.
